result.title: RemoteVLPG: How to Obtain a Specific VLM for Language-Guided Path Generation on Remote Sensing Images?
result.summary: We study how to obtain a task-specific Vision-Language Model (VLM) for language-guided path generation between start and end points on remote sensing images. We explore this question from three aspects. First, we implement three widely used architectural approaches and compare their performance. Second, we design a scalable method for constructing pre-training data and build an effective pre-training dataset with a degree of diversity. Methods trained on this dataset achieve promising zero-shot performance. Third, we construct three benchmarks that support stratified evaluation and design three metrics for path generation. We investigate this problem through extensive experiments. The results show that the zero-shot performance of methods trained on the constructed pre-training dataset can exceed that of some advanced commercial VLMs. Code and Dataset can be available at https://github.com/jzdang/RemoteVLPG

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何为遥感图像上的语言引导起终点路径生成构建专用 VLM：比较三种常用架构、设计可扩展的预训练数据构建方式并建立三个支持分层评测的基准与指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其架构对比与预训练数据构建可供核查 VLM 如何保留起点、终点与几何路径信息，与视觉细节和几何信息是否留在内部状态的问题可能相关，但论文聚焦端到端任务性能，未涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，借鉴线索有限。
